LanguageData.MSS_CFP_Settings_XenotypeOnConversion_To: When a pawn converts to your faction's primary ideoligion during play, replace their xenotype with the one chosen below. Starting colonists and newly generated pawns are not affected. Needs Ideology and Biotech.
LanguageData.MSS_CFP_Settings_ConversionXenotype_Tool: Only xenogene (non-inheritable) xenotypes can be chosen. The pawn's current xenogenes are replaced; their endogenes stay.
LanguageData.MSS_CFP_XenotypeChangedOnConversion: {PAWN_labelShort} has converted to {IDEO} and is now a {XENOTYPE}.
